classes.name: Alloy

classes.name: Specimen
classes.description: A sample of material prepared for testing.

classes.name: OxidationTest
classes.description: A test measuring oxidation behavior under specific conditions.

classes.description: A characteristic or quality of a material.

classes.name: Phase

classes.name: Composition

classes.name: Temperature
classes.description: A measure of thermal energy, typically measured in degrees Celsius or Kelvin.
